_meta.title: Watoto Playable Content Library

designTiers.parent-led: Ages 0-2: cozy, slow, real-world; parent is primary user.
designTiers.encourage-effort: Ages 3-5: friendly narrator rewards effort, never time pressure.
designTiers.gamify-gently: Ages 6-7: badges & levels, clear repeatable instructions.

universalRules: No timers / no time pressure on any item (timed=false everywhere).
Offline-playable; all assets are local refs.
Captions for all narration; adjustable speed; diverse representation.

stages.title: Sensory & Cause-and-Effect
stages.focus: Sensory-motor foundations rather than school subjects. Zero reading.

stages.title: First Words & Concepts
stages.focus: Build vocabulary and begin categorizing the world. Single-tap, no text.

stages.title: Language Explosion & Early Logic
stages.focus: Vocabulary booms; symbolic and pretend play emerge. One word / emoji max.

stages.title: Pre-Literacy & Foundational Math
stages.focus: Groundwork for reading, writing and arithmetic through play. Reward effort.

stages.title: Early Reading & Number Sense
stages.focus: Kindergarten-readiness skills, still delivered through play.

stages.title: Kindergarten: Foundations in Academic Subjects
stages.focus: More structured learning with hands-on, colorful activities. Gentle gamification.

stages.title: Grade 1: Fluency & Deeper Understanding
stages.focus: Reading fluency takes off; math grows more abstract. Badges and levels.

stages.title: Grade 2: Expanding Knowledge & Skills
stages.focus: More independent learners; longer, richer interactive lessons. Growing autonomy.

stages.title: Grade 3: Critical Thinking & Independence
stages.focus: Shift from learning-to-read to reading-to-learn; more abstract math.

stages.title: Grade 4: Abstract Thinking & Synthesis
stages.focus: Abstract reasoning, multi-step problems, technology to create.
